decision: Keep direct-value Compose as the default and add an explicit new-setup env package with a matching env_file reference and no overlapping inline environment.
rationale: The user authorized sequential remediation of the Tuniku planning backlog, including AUD-011 through AUD-014. A deliberate package selection fixes disconnected env output while preserving DEC-004 and existing installations.
compatibility: Existing-stack fragments and default Compose exports remain direct-value proposals.
Old drafts remain readable; useEnvFile is optional.
rollback: Remove the new-setup package option and its tests; preserve all pre-existing local work. Existing deployments and stored data are unchanged.
